# Quiz Answer

```{r}
z <- read.table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Desktop/STAT_443_SP_2026/guide_dataset/datafiles/ce2021.txt",header=TRUE)
zfit <- read.table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Desktop/STAT_443_SP_2026/guide_dataset/datafiles/fit_ce2021reg_feb_19.txt",header=TRUE)
S1 <- !is.na(z$INTRDVX)
S2 <- is.na(z$INTRDVX)

observed <- z$INTRDVX # yi
imputed <- zfit$predicted # yi_hot
w <- z$FINLWT21
estimate <- (sum(w[S1]*observed[S1])+sum(w[S2]*imputed[S2]))/sum(w)
estimate

weighted.mean(zfit$predicted,w)

```

Node Means
```{r}
library(dplyr)

check <- data.frame(
  node = zfit$node,
  y = z$INTRDVX,
  w = z$FINLWT21,
  pred = zfit$predicted
)



node_means <- check %>%
  group_by(node) %>%
  summarize(
    weighted_mean = sum(w*y, na.rm=TRUE)/sum(w[!is.na(y)]),
    predicted = unique(pred)
  )

node_means

```
